environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running identical gRPC pod image. PostgreSQL 15.4 on RDS with pg_hba.conf restricting 'grpc_svc_user' connections to the pod CIDR. The database role 'grpc_svc_user' was provisioned via Terraform module 'cyrilgdn/postgresql' with a restricted grant set. The role has column-level SELECT on comments(id, author, body, created_at, post_id) and no other privileges — specifically no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE on any table in the public schema. Role attributes: NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=ddl' and the cluster has Falco sidecar monitoring for anomalous DB traffic. Note: the pod ServiceAccount has no IAM role association that could escalate to RDS master credentials, and the Kubernetes Secret containing the password is mounted read-only from AWS Secrets Manager with rotation disabled for this service account.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT (id, author, body, created_at, post_id) ON comments TO grpc_svc_user
config.secrets_management: AWS Secrets Manager, rotation disabled, mounted as read-only volume
config.pod_service_account: no IRSA role attached, default token audience
config.monitoring: Falco sidecar with custom rules for DB protocol anomalies
